jobs.name: daily-hermes-agent-functional-merge-review
jobs.prompt:
Review the GitHub repository NousResearch/hermes-agent once per day and post a succinct summary of material functional changes/improvements merged in the last 24 hours.

Use live GitHub data (gh/git) and inspect enough detail to distinguish real functional changes from noise. Exclude docs-only changes, generated site output, deploy artifacts, pure metadata/version bumps, formatting-only churn, and CI-only changes unless they materially affect developer/release behavior.

Output requirements:
- Provide only the summary, with no surrounding explanation about methodology.
- Do NOT include PR numbers, commit hashes, links, or exhaustive change lists.
- Group related work into a short bullet list of material functional changes and improvements.
- Focus on user-facing behavior, runtime/tooling capabilities, reliability/security/data-integrity fixes, integrations/platform support, and developer workflow improvements.
- Keep it concise: aim for 3–8 bullets, one sentence each.
- If there were no material functional changes, output exactly: "No material functional changes merged in the last 24 hours."
